verdict: No paid leads this period; local search activity is the only signal, and fading.
narrative: No paid advertising ran on Meta or Google in the last 28 days, meaning zero leads were generated through paid channels this period. Your Google Business profiles remained active, producing 172 local actions — directions, calls, and website clicks — across three locations, but that engagement dropped 26% in the most recent seven days compared to the seven days prior, with the last three days nearly flat. One profile drew 344 impressions over the period without generating a single call, while its sister locations converted at a measurably better rate, pointing to a profile-level issue worth addressing. Paid campaigns are being prioritized for reactivation, and the underperforming profile is under review to close the gap on call conversion.

watch_item.issue: One profile received 344 impressions over 28 days but generated zero calls, well below the 0.82% call rate seen on a sister profile.
